name: urban-displacement/displacement-typologies
what_it_holds: UC Berkeley Urban Displacement Project repo (GPL-3.0, 502 commits, updated Aug 2026, 49 stars) with GeoPackage/CSV files and a codebook classifying census tracts in 8 US metros (Atlanta, Bay Area, Chicago, Cleveland, Denver, LA, Memphis, Seattle) into 8 gentrification/displacement typology categories, mostly on 2017-2018 vintage census/demographic data. Confirmed by fetch: no Airbnb/STR variables included.
why_useful: Relevant to gap #13 (long-term rental/housing economics, host-supply pressure) as a housing-displacement/gentrification classification that could be joined to STR listing density by tract to study host-supply drivers, though it carries no STR data itself.
themes: University and municipal research datasets on STRs published on GitHub (city planning departments, urban labs, McGill UPGo, Inside Airbnb collaborators)

name: montreal-finance-2022
what_it_holds: Code for the paper 'High rises and housing stress: A spatial big-data analysis of rental housing financialization' — includes R/, latex/, stan/ (Bayesian spatial model) and output/ folders. An academic paper replication package on rental-housing financialization and displacement in Montreal.
why_useful: Housing-financialization angle on host supply economics; tangential to gap #13 but a genuine published methodology, not just an Airbnb rehash.
themes: UPGo (McGill) and strr R package: STR research tooling and datasets for Canada/US cities
why_all: Housing-financialization angle on host supply economics; tangential to gap #13 but a genuine published methodology, not just an Airbnb rehash.
